title: TelltaleDNS
description: TelltaleDNS resolver: traffic, latency, upstream health, filtering, cache. Generated by deploy/grafana/build.py.

panels.title: Queries / s
panels.description: All DNS queries, every transport and outcome.

panels.title: Blocked
panels.description: Share of queries blocked by filter lists.

panels.title: Cache hits
panels.description: Fresh cache hits over all cache lookups.

panels.title: Upstream p95
panels.description: 95th percentile upstream exchange time, all upstreams.

panels.title: Upstreams down
panels.description: Upstreams whose circuit breaker is open (benched after failures).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set size of the TelltaleDNS process.

panels.title: Queries by status
panels.description: Queries per second by how they were answered.

panels.title: Responses by RCODE
panels.description: Responses per second by response code.

panels.title: Answer time by path (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Receive-to-answer time per answer path (cache, upstream, local, synthesized).

panels.title: Where time goes
panels.description: Stage times (waiting for upstreams) against total answer times.

panels.title: Upstream latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Per-upstream exchange time, including prefetches (OBS-011).

panels.title: Upstream share of traffic
panels.description: Attempts per second per upstream.

panels.title: Upstream failure rate
panels.description: Timeouts, errors, SERVFAIL/REFUSED as a share of attempts.

targets.expr: sum by (upstream) (rate(telltale_upstream_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="failure"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (upstream) (rate(telltale_upstream_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Circuit breakers
panels.description: 0 closed (healthy), 1 half-open (probing), 2 open (benched).

panels.title: Blocked by list
panels.description: Blocks per second by the deciding list (top 10).

panels.title: Blocked by group
panels.description: Blocks per second by the client's group.

panels.title: Lists
panels.description: Entries each list contributes, and hours since it was last confirmed current.

panels.title: Cache activity
panels.description: Cache lookups and maintenance per second.

panels.title: Cache size
panels.description: Approximate cache memory.

panels.title: Top clients
panels.description: Queries per second for the busiest clients. Needs [telemetry.metrics] per_client = true.

panels.title: Queries by transport
panels.description: Queries per second over UDP, TCP, DoT, DoH, and DoQ.

panels.title: Encrypted DNS problems
panels.description: Clients that couldn't talk to the encrypted listeners: an expired or wrong certificate, a broken client, or a load balancer without PROXY protocol.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the most recent start of any selected node.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Starts in the selected time range, every node (a new pod with an empty data directory counts from 1).

panels.title: After a crash or a kill
panels.description: Starts after a run that didn't stop cleanly: a crash, an OOM kill, a power cut.

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Times the container's memory limit killed a process (cgroup v2).

panels.title: Telemetry and query log
panels.description: Dropped events/rows mean the analytics fell behind; answers never wait for them.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the process, and what the machine has left.

panels.title: Machine
panels.description: How busy each node's machine is (all cores).

panels.title: Temperature and disk
panels.description: CPU temperature (a Pi throttles near 80 °C) and free space where the data directory is.

targets.expr: min by (instance) (telltale_data_filesystem_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind="free"} / telltale_data_filesystem_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind="total"} * 100)
